semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides specialized valves essential for maintaining the integrity and efficiency of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Asian Valve Co., Ltd. manufactures high-performance valves specifically designed for the semiconductor industry. Their products include PVDF/HP-PVDF valves for high-purity applications, PPH/HP-PPH valves for chemical handling, and CLEAN PVC valves for cleanroom environments. These valves are crucial for ensuring the proper handling of chemicals and maintaining controlled environments in semiconductor fabrication facilities.
capabilities: CLEAN PVC valves for cleanroom environments
